name: Golden Genie And The Walking Wilds

features.name: Genie Wishes
features.description: Aladdin and his lamp turn into multiplier wilds.

features.name: Genie Lamps
features.description: Wild reels 2 and 4, with wins paying both ways.

review:
Golden Genie and the Walking Wilds is a 5x3 Arabian-nights slot. Aligning Aladdin with his lamp triggers Genie Wishes, turning both into wilds with x2 to x10 multipliers. Genie Lamps can cover reels 2 and 4 with wilds and make wins pay both ways.

Three genie symbols start Genie Parade, where genie wilds walk left each spin and build up their multipliers. Nolimit rates it High volatility, with a 9,583x cap and a 34% hit rate. A good entry point to the studio.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
